LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_HardyLabor.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} can take hardship, and will keep at unpleasant work.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_FieldGleaner.degreeDatas.0.de: {PAWN_nameDef} is used to picking through edges and waste ground for anything edible.
{PAWN_nameDef} is good with animals. Even frightened livestock will come close to {PAWN_objective}.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_WellBearer.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} can take a lot of weight without minding the load.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_MoldSifter.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} can tell which grain can still be cooked.
{PAWN_nameDef} is handy with roofs and wooden frames.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_RagTailor.degreeDatas.0.label: mender
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_RagTailor.degreeDatas.0.descr: {PAWN_nameDef} is good at stitching rags and old felt into something usable.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_HerbReader.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} knows which herbs still bring a fever down, and can be trusted with a bandage.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_NightFugitive.degreeDatas.0.d: {PAWN_nameDef} prefers to move at night, and doesn't stumble much in the dark.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_SnowGuide.degreeDatas.0.label: pathwise
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_SnowGuide.degreeDatas.0.descr: {PAWN_nameDef} remembers old trail markers and tracks buried in snow.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_DustBearer.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} will carry grain and water all the way to the next camp, and rarely puts the load down.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_CampWatcher.degreeDatas.0.des: {PAWN_nameDef} doesn't panic easily. When the camp is in chaos, {PAWN_pronoun} can still keep a clear head.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_AlmsSpeaker.degreeDatas.0.des: {PAWN_nameDef} has a way with words. Even hard news comes out in a way people will listen to.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_JunkAppraiser.degreeDatas.0.d: {PAWN_nameDef} can tell what a sack of old goods is still worth, and is sharp in a trade.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_GrainMediator.degreeDatas.0.d: {PAWN_nameDef} steps in before a crowd starts grabbing, and can keep a situation from falling apart.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_WoundTender.degreeDatas.0.des: {PAWN_nameDef} has a steady hand with wounds, and smell or crying rarely stops {PAWN_objective}.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_EggKeeper.degreeDatas.0.label: broody
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_EggKeeper.degreeDatas.0.descr: {PAWN_nameDef} puts the young first. If a child nearby goes hungry or falls ill, {PAWN_pronoun} takes it hard.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_LeanHunger.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} is used to splitting one meal into two, and can keep going on an empty stomach.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_ThickFur.degreeDatas.0.label: thick-furred
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_FinePaws.degreeDatas.0.label: deft
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_FinePaws.degreeDatas.0.descri: {PAWN_nameDef} has a sure hand with fine work like mending sacks and threading needles.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_PathScout.degreeDatas.0.label: alert
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_PathScout.degreeDatas.0.descr: {PAWN_nameDef} notices movement early and checks the path before stepping.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_ColumnLead.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} lines people up before moving. Who walks first and who watches the young is for {PAWN_pronoun} to decide.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_ReliefCook.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} can turn a little grain into a hot meal that can still be shared.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_FamineHunter.degreeDatas.0.de: {PAWN_nameDef} likes to pin prey up close, and moves quietly on the approach.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_HungerRage.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} sees food and the eyes go red. The emptier the stomach, the harder it is to keep still.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_FoodSnatcher.degreeDatas.0.de: {PAWN_nameDef} can hardly watch food pass by. When hungry, the paws go to the sack first.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_PlagueDread.degreeDatas.0.des: {PAWN_nameDef} is especially afraid of plague. Being sick, or seeing someone nearby fall ill, makes {PAWN_pronoun} uneasy.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_NightTerrors.degreeDatas.0.de: {PAWN_nameDef} sleeps lightly and wakes at small sounds. Tiredness only makes the panic worse.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_FamineSloth.degreeDatas.0.des: {PAWN_nameDef} is a little lazy, and will rest if there's a chance to rest.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_GrainGreed.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} can't stop eating while food is in reach, and hunger hits hard.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_Distrustful.degreeDatas.0.des: {PAWN_nameDef} has a hard time trusting anyone. Even kindness often looks like a trap to {PAWN_objective}.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_WeakFlesh.degreeDatas.0.label: frail
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_WeakFlesh.degreeDatas.0.descr: {PAWN_nameDef} is frail, and doesn't take knocks well.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_WeakGut.degreeDatas.0.label: queasy
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_WeakGut.degreeDatas.0.descrip: {PAWN_nameDef} has a weak gut, and gets hungry again soon after a meal.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_Chillblood.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} hates the cold. When the wind picks up, {PAWN_pronoun} suffers for it.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_FamineGloom.degreeDatas.0.des: {PAWN_nameDef} has a hard time believing anything good is coming, and cracks more easily under pressure.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_WailingYoung.degreeDatas.0.de: {PAWN_nameDef} is still small, and cries easily when hungry or cold.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_BitingYoung.degreeDatas.0.des: {PAWN_nameDef} hasn't learned to hide hunger. Near food, or when grabbed, biting follows.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_AlmsHate.degreeDatas.0.label: proud
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_AlmsHate.degreeDatas.0.descri: {PAWN_nameDef} treats charity as a humiliation, and won't bow to give thanks after taking what's offered.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_GrudgeKeeper.degreeDatas.0.de: {PAWN_nameDef} remembers who shut a gate and who took what was needed. The next meeting starts with the old grudge.
{PAWN_nameDef} survived plague once. Illness is easier to endure now, but tiredness comes more quickly.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_GrainSneak.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} doesn't show what is really wanted, and moves quietly when closing in.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_SiegeDigger.degreeDatas.0.des: {PAWN_nameDef} is good with a shovel, especially digging ways out and trenches.
{PAWN_nameDef} doesn't mind a close fight. The fists are ready before the sentence is finished.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_AilingMother.degreeDatas.0.de: {PAWN_nameDef} puts the children first. If a child is hungry or sick, {PAWN_pronoun} unravels.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_FamilyThief.degreeDatas.0.des: {PAWN_nameDef} puts kin above rules. If the young of the den go hungry or fall ill, {PAWN_pronoun} can't sit still.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_QuarantineGuard.degreeDatas.0: {PAWN_nameDef} is hard to get close to, and keeps people apart with a firm hand and few words.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_WrongKin.degreeDatas.0.label: gullible
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_WrongKin.degreeDatas.0.descri: {PAWN_nameDef} will take a strange door for home, and takes it hard when that guess is wrong.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_CrowdChild.degreeDatas.0.desc: {PAWN_nameDef} is more at ease in a crowd, and talks poorly when left alone.
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_WildHole.degreeDatas.0.label: feral
LanguageData.RHAH_Trait_WildHole.degreeDatas.0.descri: {PAWN_nameDef} looks first for cover, then for anything edible. Waste ground feels safer to {PAWN_objective} than a storehouse.
